title: Dataset of intracranial EEG during cortical stimulations evoking negative motor responses
description: This dataset comprises intracranial EEG recordings from 23 patients with drug-resistant epilepsy undergoing stereo-EEG presurgical evaluation. The dataset includes 41 high-frequency stimulation events that evoked negative motor responses, with 24-second iEEG recordings per stimulation event (9-10 seconds pre-stimulation, up to 5 seconds stimulation, and 9-10 seconds post-stimulation). Stimulation parameters, contact pairs, current intensities, and evoked effects are documented in event files, enabling analysis of cortical responses to electrical stimulation.
methods_description: High-frequency bipolar intracranial stimulations were delivered using biphasic pulses (1 ms duration) at frequencies of 43.2 Hz (alternating polarity) or 50 Hz (non-alternating), with current intensities ranging from 0.25 to 3 mA for up to 5 seconds. iEEG data were recorded for 24 seconds around each stimulation event, including pre-stimulation baseline (9-10 seconds) and post-stimulation periods (9-10 seconds). Two 5-second epochs (pre- and post-stimulation) were extracted for connectivity analysis.
